scripts.build: xcodebuild -project Ottam.xcodeproj -scheme Ottam -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=${IOS_SIMULATOR_NAME:-iPhone 17 Pro}" -derivedDataPath DerivedDataBuild build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.test: xcodebuild -project Ottam.xcodeproj -scheme Ottam -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=${IOS_SIMULATOR_NAME:-iPhone 17 Pro}" -derivedDataPath DerivedDataTest test
scripts.typecheck: xcodebuild -project Ottam.xcodeproj -scheme Ottam -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath DerivedDataTypecheck build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO ARCHS=arm64 ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES
